fields.description:
## v0.13.1 Link lifecycle staging amendment

Add these Deal-driven Link scenarios:

* Deal Pause: only currently Active Links become inactive; pre-existing inactive Links stay inactive.
* Paused → Active: only Links that were Active immediately before Pause are restored.
* Deal Inactive: no Link state changes.
* Deal Close: Active Links become inactive; Closed → Active leaves them inactive.
* Deal Archive: Active Links become inactive until/unless a Link-level Archived state is later adopted.
* No Pause/Close/Archive action changes DRAs from Salesforce.

A Link-level Archived status is a separate follow-up and should be added to this staging plan only after that decision is made.

## Source of truth

<custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-0">https://jumpr.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/JK/pages/269090817/03+User+Stories+Jira+Disposition</custom>

## Outcome

Once CMS staging processes Links, prove Link storage, identity, payload fields, request coalescing, publication markers and safe exclusion/deletion against the real CMS.

## Required scenarios

* WAGR-499 authoritative Tracking URL stores/sends >255 characters without truncation up to approved limit.
* Link Code respects the final approved length policy; overlength values are not silently truncated.
* add/edit/deactivate eligible Link.
* payload includes both `sf_link_id` and `link_external_id`.
* inactive Link sent as `active:false`.
* complete CMS-eligible Link snapshot.
* one Deal with roughly **70 Links** (\~2× current Airtable maximum).
* same Link Code/URL on different Deals creates separate Link records/identities.
* re-parent attempt blocked through UI/API.
* multiple Link updates for one Deal create one logical parent Deal request.
* API/Data Loader bulk changes collapse requests by Deal.
* Assignment Cap semantics.
* Test/Exclude-from-CMS eligibility.
* CMS rejection such as `link_owned_by_other`.

## Publication / deletion scenarios

* Never-published Link may follow controlled delete path.
* Queueing a sync does not stamp publication success.
* Successful parent send containing Link stamps/updates publication markers.
* Published Active Link cannot be excluded/deleted.
* Link set Inactive but not yet confirmed by CMS remains blocked.
* After successful payload containing `active:false`, last-published state is Inactive and delete eligibility can proceed only under confirmed omission contract.
* Standard record/list/related-list/API delete paths cannot bypass backend guard.
* Unrelated Link edit does not restamp First/Last Published.

## Contract-dependent scenario

Before production deletion/exclusion is enabled, Strah must confirm whether omission of a previously-known Link retains its last-known CMS state. Test that explicitly if adopted. If not supported, stop and revise rather than silently treating omission as delete.

## Field-level verification

Compare every mapped Link field with the CMS staging row using approved read-only access.

## Done when

Every applicable Link scenario passes with evidence and Strah confirms Link state/omission semantics.
